Silicon(IV) oxide reacts with chlorine and carbon to form liquid silicon(IV) chloride, SiCl4, and
carbon dioxide gas.
If the reaction is carried out at r.t.p., which symbol equation represents this reaction?
SiO2(l)  +  2Cl2(g)  +  C(s)  →  SiCl4(l)  +  CO2(g)
A
SiO2(l)  +  2Cl2(g)  +  C(g)  →  SiCl4(l)  +  CO2(g)
B
SiO2(s)  +  2Cl2(g)  +  C(s)  →  SiCl4(g)  +  CO2(g)
C
SiO2(s)  +  2Cl2(g)  +  C(s)  →  SiCl4(l)  +  CO2(g)
D
subject: Chemistry
